context.content: Am I missing something or why does no one, literally no one, wear masks in the supermarkets or other closed spaces now that they are not mandatory? In light of the recent events, I'd assume that more people would be concerned and wear their masks but it seems that despite very well known information that the masks are the best way to stop the spread, the Dutch try to avoid them at all cost. At this point it seems like it would be a common sense. It's a respiratory disease after all! In case I am missing something, please let me know. Edit: Wow guys, I never thought I would generate so much discussion about the usage of masks! Let's keep it going! 💪 My own sources as to why masks reduce the spread: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-020-72798-7 https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-020-02801-8 https://www.pnas.org/content/118/4/e2014564118
